title: Send the part file with the print job
goal: A print request carries the part file from the Mac library to the slicing base, verified, cached and re-sent only when changed
acceptance: The file travels over the Kaji line as a signed message with its SHA-256, size-capped like F-062-T06 backup copies; the receiver verifies signature and hash before writing
Tabgha writes only inside its prints cache (%USERPROFILE%\.nerv\prints-cache); names are content hashes, never sender paths
A file already cached with the same hash is not sent again; a changed file is
A test across the join: Mac base sends, Tabgha base receives, verifies and slices from the cache with a fake slicer; a tampered or oversized file is refused
privacy: Neutral fixtures only; the owner's part files never enter Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 at agent speed. Not a measurement.
